title: OXYGEN Onboarding
description: Guide OXYGEN onboarding: company context, first leads, a reviewed sequence, sender and bounded launch; set up daily Oxygent routines when requested. Use for 'get me started' or the first campaign and morning briefing. For a GTM diagnosis or plan, use oxygen-gtm-consultant.

plays/day-1-first-win.md.title: Day 1: from your offer to your warmest leads

day-1-first-win.title: Day 1: from your offer to your warmest leads
day-1-first-win.label: Your warmest leads
day-1-first-win.summary: Write down what you sell and who buys it, then get the ten people to contact first.
day-1-first-win.prompt: Work out what we sell and who our ideal customer is from what you can find, then list the ten people I should contact first, warmest first, and draft my first messages.
trigger_phrases: I just signed up — what do I actually do with this?
Where do I start with Oxygen?
What should I do in my first session?
day-1-first-win.business_case: You just signed up and don't know where to start. In one free session, write down what you sell and who buys it, then find the ten people you can contact today, warmest first, before buying any data.
day-1-first-win.outcome: Offer and ideal customer saved as labelled drafts, a table of about ten people to contact first (warm contacts when you have them, real matches from a free search otherwise) with a reason each, and first messages for the top 3-5. 0 credits, nothing sent.
day-1-first-win.leading_metric: people ranked with a reason and first messages drafted in the first session
day-1-first-win.benchmark: with no CRM, inbox or LinkedIn connected, the free people search still names about ten real buyers in one session; warm contacts, when they exist, reply far more often

effort.time_to_value: same session: offer, ideal customer and a ranked people table
effort.cadence: once per workspace, then daily through daily-warm-lead-queue

prerequisites.detail: Signed in on any plan, including free; day 1 spends no credits
What you sell and who buys it: already saved, or drafted in step 2 from your website
Optional: where your contacts live (CRM records, a connected mailbox or LinkedIn account, or a customer list or LinkedIn Connections.csv in your folder)
